note: Projection of the canonical preview/ephemeral-environment registry for the Ovie HUD. Lane ids are kept in sync with the registry by scripts/lib/__tests__/preview-env-contract.test.mjs. activeExceptions is maintained by cleanup/reconciliation receipts; expired or unknown entries never count as valid certification evidence.

lanes.surface: ephemeral Neon branch ci-neon-run-<run_id>-<attempt> (isolated database only)
lanes.evidencePurpose: Database-affecting proof that cannot be obtained from normal CI or the shared staging database.
lanes.cleanupTrigger: Neon branch TTL (expires_in_hours=2); neon-scheduled-cleanup daily heartbeat reconciles missed events
lanes.costBudget: One Neon branch with at most 2h of endpoint compute per dispatch
